title: Experts disagree on feature.json base_branch
context:
Chief architect: Ruled by the chief, no question needed: the claims fit together. Recording the real fork branch as the pull request target stays out of scope, and old bundles that recorded main with no fork point read correctly by falling back to the recorded start_commit, with no migration of old bundles.

Target: feature.json base_branch
- solution-architect: Recording the real fork branch (for example a release branch) in base_branch for the pull request target is out of scope; this change only stops measuring the change's own work against it.
- application-architect: existing bundles that recorded base_branch main and no fork point must still read correctly by falling back to delivery.json start_commit; no migration of old bundles
